name: street1983nk/findling
description: Zero-config full text search companion app, registers the search provider and proxies into the ExApp container
_comment: phpunit/phpunit is pinned to an exact version and not to a caret range, and the major is not a taste decision. The suite runs with the tests/bootstrap.php of nextcloud/server, which means it runs inside the autoload space of the server, and two PHPUnit versions in one process is not a state anybody wants to debug. nextcloud/server carries phpunit/phpunit ^11.5 in vendor-bin/phpunit/composer.json on stable34, which is the branch the phpunit job of .github/workflows/php.yml checks out, so the major here is 11 for that reason and has to move with that branch.
11 is also the highest major that still runs on the php >=8.2 this app declares: PHPUnit 12 requires 8.3 and PHPUnit 13 requires 8.4.1.

The dependency is require-dev and is installed in CI only. Neither it nor a vendor directory of the tests reaches the release archive; plan 05-18 builds that archive and asserts exactly this. The runtime requirement of the app is the php constraint above and nothing else.

The package itself was cleared by the owner before it was fetched, because the package legitimacy audit of this phase lists no packages at all: source repository sebastianbergmann/phpunit, 991 million downloads, actively released. See 05-15-SUMMARY.md.
